author: robin-dev
title: Show receipt PDF amounts in the company's currency
body:
## Scope

Receipt PDF lines show each amount as `12.34 EUR` instead of raw cents (EX-70, milestone 1).

linkedIssue.body: Receipt PDFs show each line's amount in the company's currency, as `12.34 EUR`. Milestone 1: every company is on EUR. EX-71 adds other currencies in a later milestone.
